review_evidence: README identifies LiterateLean as a Lean 4 library implementing markdown-like prose with elaborated fenced Lean command blocks.

The library and fixture sources exercise the custom syntax, including accepted, ordinary-import, scope-disabled, unterminated-fence and intentionally invalid Lean cases; these fixtures are retained because they provide concrete source-level interface/behavior evidence rather than being excluded by test naming.

Complete inspection of Tests/Main.lean found only a TestCase record, subprocess runner, PASS/FAIL printing and a main function invoking Lean on fixture paths; it defines no LiterateLean syntax or reusable formal result.
